messages:
Sam: Quick pre-QBR pulse for NovaGen — onboarding + cost signals. They've spiked embeddings over the last 48h and credits are down to ~12% of initial. Need a short list of actions for the QBR: 30-day burn forecast, throttle suggestions, enablement asks, and a promo-credit contingency. @Elaine can you run a 30-day burn forecast? @Tess any infra flags? @Michael (AM) what do we want to show the customer? TL;DR: avoid renewal friction.

Elaine: On it. Running a quick query now. ETA ~20m. I'll include three scenarios: baseline (current growth), conservative (throttle 25% embeddings + batching), and optimized (quant/embedding-size reductions + prefix cache).

Michael: We should present cost vs value: top 3 features driving token usage, suggested rate-limit policy, and one actionable ask for contracting (small top-up vs opt-in throttles). Confirming they're on hosted — yes, hosted account.

Tess: No infra incidents. Noticing lots of short-tail long-seq embedding calls causing batching inefficiencies. Recommend prefix caching + reduce max_tokens for embed calls. Suggest a 10% transient throttle on embeddings as a quick mitigation :thinking_face:

Onboard-Bot: Alert: account_novagen credit_balance=1200 credits (~12% of starting allocation), avg_usage_rate=~900 credits/day, projected_runway=~1.3 weeks. Auto-report generated at 5600001234.

Sam: Thanks. Elaine — include exact runway numbers and a conversion table (tokens -> credits and credits -> USD). Also include a scenario with a 20% usage reduction. Michael — can you prepare a 2-slide ask for the customer: "budget cushion" OR "enable conservative throttles + optimization engagement". Make it customer-friendly.

Elaine: Posting the forecast query I'll run so you can reproduce:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'novagen' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```
Will export the counts and a projected-runway CSV. Graph + table in the QBR packet.

Michael: Draft ask language: "We recommend a 90-day runway target. Options: 1) one-time top-up (20% credits) to reach runway, or 2) enable conservative throttles and schedule a 1-hour optimization session. We can make the top-up contingent on a short-term success plan." I'll refine slides and share by EOD.

Sam: Can someone spell out the exact enablement steps the onboarding team should deliver before QBR? Example checklist: 1) Walkthrough of embedding payloads + sizing, 2) Implement prefix cache snippet, 3) Quick batching config, 4) 1-hour optimization session. @Marta can you own the session?

Marta: I'll own the optimization session. I'll prepare a checklist and an agenda: metric review (10m), instrumentation run (15m), live prompt/size tweaks (20m), batching & KV cache demo (15m). I'll also draft a one-pager of suggested prompt changes. ETA EOD today.

Sam: Action items recap: Elaine — forecast + runway numbers (due in 2 hrs), Michael — 2-slide customer ask (EOD), Marta — optimization prep (EOD), Tess — propose throttle config (in thread). @Jordan (AE) if we need to request promo credits, flag here. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Saw this. If Elaine's forecast shows <2 weeks runway, I'll escalate for a 1-month top-up approval. If runway is >2 weeks but <4, I'll offer a discretionary 2-week buffer credit. Standing by.

Tess: Proposed throttle config (72h trial): reduce embeddings RPM from 60 -> 45 for 72h; automatic rollback after 72h OR when 7-day avg usage drops 20%. Pseudo-config below:
```
throttle:
  target_rpm: 45
  duration: 72h
  rollback_condition: "7d_avg_usage < baseline * 0.8"
  metrics_to_monitor: ["credits/day","errors/5m","p99_latency"]
```
Will also add an alert to auto-lift if error rate increases.

Sam: Perfect — that covers it. Elaine, post the CSV/graph here when ready and I'll assemble the QBR packet. Thanks everyone.
